title: Movement optimization experiments
method: Generic Cargo release (ThinLTO, codegen-units1) for engine APIs; rustc -O for isolated speculative kernels. taskset CPU2, no concurrent compilers or sibling timing. Engine API screen two arm-order passes (B,C then C,B),5 batchmeans per arm per pass,minimum20ms per batch. Target/direct query kernels cover7families x3densities; legal4modes on opening+6VPSpositions. Standalone kernels5batchmeans per arm minimum12ms per batch. Primary geometry covers all5041unique deltas with equal-noinline function boundaries; diagonal-only/unequal-boundary versions are diagnostics excluded from general comparisons. Ranges are batch means, not request tail latencies or confidence intervals.

findings.result: Across all6VPS positions,4modes,outputreuse and freshoutput, move counts match. Reused All output: opening97->92allocations; plies24/701/161/1400/420/931 respectively192->184,192->192,168->164,261->53,199->198,194->194. Late1400 requested bytes11504->1344.
findings.limits: Cumulative requested bytes and alloc/realloc call counts, not peak/live memory; warm single-thread global allocator census, no latency measured under counting allocator. Aggregate bundle attribution.

findings.status: Promising / proven with small-list regression rejected
findings.decision: Keep bitmap only for large lists; preserve baseline stable sort below64 and skip lists smaller than2
findings.result: Empty Rook70targets595.8->363.1ns (39.1%faster), directly exposing large-union policy. Trial used unstable sort below64: sparse Rook50targets472.1->584.9ns (+23.9%) and Pawn0/1targets+5–16%; reject that small-list unstable-sort variant. Legal generation all6VPS ordered checksums match.
findings.limits: Whole Tengu/Hook results combine ray streaming+bitmap and cannot be attributed to bitmap alone. Final lean source differs from timed trial by retaining stable small-list sorting and skipping already ordered singleton/empty lists. Parent whole-search bitmap ablation decides inclusion.

findings.result: Narrow perpendicular second directions before traversal, use original board because neither ray crosses vacated origin/occupied corner. Raw-order parity against physically moved Board passes. Empty Tengu39.48->7.60us; empty Hook67.60->14.89us. Late1400 legalAll25.17->14.18us and captures8.52->3.60us for bundle.
findings.limits: Numbers combine narrowing+streaming+union. Applies only RangeRange through empty corner; short TwoStep and othercapabilities retain existing occupancy semantics.

findings.result: Nested second Range targets now visit caller output directly, removing per-corner secondVec allocations. Late1400 reusedAll261->53allocations; all4legalmode ordered checksums preserved for7fixtures.
findings.limits: First-leg Vecs and short/non-range nested capability Vecs remain. Broader recursive visitor conversion was not attempted; measured benefit only for scoped RangeRange streaming.

findings.result: Eight source-direction branches become exact half-byte rotation. Prior audit exhaustively tested256masks/2colors and release assembly11->3instructions includingret. Current all-piece rotation tests and full lib suite pass.
findings.limits: No isolated whole-search latency attribution; included in movement bundle. Cached descriptors already avoid many rotations.

findings.decision: Ship fixed Direction arrays and delete unread target-onlyFEpath
findings.result: Direction::ALL fixed array preserves order and compatibility Vec API; legal FE fixed forward2/other6lists, fallback pattern scans and conditional diagonal lists avoid heap direction storage. Target-onlyFE discarded path Vec removed; route-bearing legalFE paths remain. Opening generation105->100allocationcalls with same280moves.
findings.limits: Opening allocation reduction is combined cleanup attribution; do not claim route paths disappeared or all array sites individually allocate in optimized machine code.

findings.status: Dubious / rejected for naive exported dispatch
findings.result: Specialized reach saves huge query fanout (emptyTengu1015.02->0.900us per42queries), but ordinaryPawn42queries0.223->0.282us (+26.5%),Rook0.332->0.384us (+15.5%). Board attack dispatcher already uses these specialized probes, limiting workflow gain. Independent review found legacy OldKite-is_promoted classifier mismatch with MovementConfig.
findings.limits: Naive CannonSoldier dispatch also recurses via its existing fallback and was removed before final validation. Future capability-driven dispatch could avoid common-case cost, but no such implementation measured. Reject trial Piece change even though selected proper-promotion fixtures passed.

findings.result: Direct geometry tests only requested diagonal/distance and required empty3/4steps. 42query batches empty4.762->0.810us; sparse5.045->0.804us; dense3.935->0.787us.
findings.limits: Guarded to actual base3/conditional4or5 configurations; arbitrary public capabilities fall back unchanged. New custom [6]/[1,2,9] tests preserve old generated semantics. Search attribution not isolated.

findings.result: For actual4forward/3other configuration, all non-origin special-return destinations already lie on the ordinary traversable multi-move rays. Directed probe scans only target ray through enemy chain, blocks on friendly. 42query batches16.27->0.610us empty;17.76->0.569us sparse;15.89->0.468us dense.
findings.limits: Only target reach, not complete path or victim identity; legal FE route builder remains unchanged. Other max-distance configurations preserve fallback. Ordinary clear-range capability still short-circuits first.

findings.status: Dubious / rejected for current Pawn workloads
findings.limits: Mask construction, mutation, output order restoration, promotions and actual Move emission excluded. Normal36pawn workload already loses; unusually dense96pawn case insufficient justification.

findings.decision: Retain as future common-class visitor experiment
findings.result: One-step common movement kernel: precompiled offsets ~19–21%faster for5directions,~24–25%for8directions,1direction unchanged (~1.75ns).
findings.limits: Only center-square target-count/hash primitive. Setup, classification, descriptor footprint, bounds, multi-step blockers, Move emission and cache effects excluded; existing configs cached. No engine-level benefit established.

findings.decision: Do not multiply generator implementations yet
findings.result: Same-boundary NoJump ray-count kernels range from8.5%faster to4.9%slower; several arms unchanged within small batch spread. Generic compiler already removes/unswitches much work.
findings.limits: Primitive NoJump count only, not allblockingmodes/Vecemission. Mixed results and code-size tradeoff prevent confident positive workflow claim.

findings.decision: Retain mixed-delta hot-table primitive as speculative; no engine integration
findings.result: Fair full5041unique-delta batch 7006.39->4709.29ns, candidate/base0.672; per-query1.390->0.934ns. Both functions equalnoinline boundaries and sameblackbox inputs; checksums match. Table10082bytes for direction+distance. Prior diagonal-only and unequal-boundary results excluded from general claim.
findings.limits: Uniform coordinate-difference primitive; warm10082byte direction+distance table, not engine query distribution. Main current direction-only inlined helper and engine cache pressure can differ.

measurements.method: Both algebra and table functions #[inline(never)] with identical black_box on coordinate inputs and dataset. idx=(i*173)%5041 enumerates all5041 deltas; table reference blackboxed; tasksetCPU2quietwindow. Prior diagonal-only result retained as diagnostic, not general measurement.
measurements.limits: Uniform coordinate-difference primitive; warm10082byte direction+distance table, not engine query distribution. Main current direction-only inlined helper and engine cache pressure can differ.

findings.result: Removing dedup after sorting an already unique list saves~2–22%in1..64target clone+sortkernels; representative8/16targets19.74->15.41ns and40.74->34.82ns.
findings.limits: Requires disjointness proof and still sorting for file-major output. CurrentSimple raw duplicate semantics and overlapping capabilities prevent blanket skip. Classification/guard cost and existing bitmap large-list policy excluded.

findings.decision: Add focused physical-board and custom-capability tests
findings.result: New narrowed-ray test compares to physically moving a cloned Board, then unrestricted raw second fanout filtered by perpendicular geometry:96family/color/origin/density fixtures and bothcapturemodes. New directed-probe tests compare all1296targets on108blocked/edge/center positions (139968checks);24customconditional configurations add31104checks. Adaptive union7size/ordercases.
findings.limits: Rules descriptors still shared for each individual leg; physically updated occupancy and independent perpendicular geometry avoid relying on the optimized overlay/mask. No new rulebug asserted. Four new tests bring lib total552passed4ignored.

Only scratch construction/consumption primitive; no overflow, recursive ownership or public Vec return conversion. Returning Vec after inline fill could reintroduce allocation and copy; hot common generation already appends into final output. Do not size per-search stack for worst fanout.

findings.decision: Ship two remaining immediate MI capture-ray consumers
findings.result: Replaced two get_path_positions Vec constructions in MinimalIntelligencePlayer with existing path_positions iterator, including early-exit attacker hit check. Main GameState, MoveDelta and search victim walks already stream.
findings.limits: No whole-search speed attribution; NNUE benchmark agents do not use MI decision path. Existing exhaustive1296x1296path iterator parity test and full lib tests pass. Removes Vec allocation/storage without changing geometry/off-ray behavior.

limits: Engine API timing trial included rejected src/piece.rs dispatch and rejected small-list unstable sort. All raw results are retained and clearly labeled trial, not final lean source.
Batchmeans from two counterbalanced passes are not independent request samples or confidence intervals.
VPS corpus consists of six board snapshots at plies24,701,161,1400,420,931 from3games; restore resets prior history/repetition.
standalone_spec_reproduction: rustc -O examples/speed_movement_spec.rs -o /tmp/movement-spec; taskset -c 2 /tmp/movement-spec; taskset -c 2 /tmp/movement-spec geometry. Optional geometry-diagonal reproduces prior diagnostic.

final_ablation.contents: Trial production movement changes with Piece dispatch restored to HEAD and final target union restored to baseline stable-sort+dedup. Rays/streaming/fixed arrays/rotation/guarded WoodenDove+FEprobes/MI iterator preserved.
